title: Add full clean-boot reset and fix blank screen after login with reliable /dashboard redirect

requirements.text: Implement a “full clean boot” reset flow that wipes all client-side persisted state (auth session, cart, wishlist, and any related local/session storage used by storefront auth) and returns the app to a clean first-run state.

quotes: Wipe everything for a fully clean boot. Reset all data (cart, wishlist, session) — I don't mind losing temporary items.

acceptanceCriteria: After invoking the reset flow, the following are cleared from browser storage: OTP session, flash message, return path, OTP lockout state/attempts, cart, and wishlist.
After invoking the reset flow, the user is logged out of Internet Identity in the app context (if previously logged in).
After invoking the reset flow, navigating to /dashboard redirects to /login and does not show a blank screen.

requirements.text: Add an explicit emergency reset entry point that a user can trigger even when the app is in a broken auth/routing state (e.g., a dedicated route like /reset or a /login query flag) which executes the full clean boot reset and then navigates to the Sign In view.
acceptanceCriteria: There is a documented, testable way to trigger the reset using only the browser URL (no prior navigation required).
After triggering the reset entry point, the app ends on /login?tab=signin (or equivalent Sign In state) and renders normally.

requirements.text: Fix the post-login redirect behavior so that successful login (OTP flow and Internet Identity flow) navigates to /dashboard (or to a stored return path if it exists and is safe), and ensure the redirect happens consistently without a blank screen on first load.

quotes: Please force reset auth state, fix dashboard route, and make login load /dashboard properly without crash.
Wipe everything for a fully clean boot. Reset all data (cart, wishlist, session) — I don't mind losing temporary items.

acceptanceCriteria: After successful OTP verification, the app navigates to /dashboard when no return path is set.
After successful Internet Identity login, the app navigates to /dashboard when no return path is set.
If a return path exists, it is used instead of /dashboard, and the return path is cleared after navigation.
A hard refresh immediately after login does not produce a blank screen and the user remains on a valid route.

requirements.text: Resolve the dashboard route first-load crash by making /dashboard render safely when auth state is restoring and when backend/query dependencies are not yet ready; show a non-blank loading or fallback UI instead of rendering nothing or crashing.

quotes: The blank screen is still there after hard refresh and revert. Please force reset auth state, fix dashboard route, and make login load /dashboard properly without crash.

acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /dashboard never results in a permanently blank screen; if data is loading, a visible loading state is rendered.
If an error occurs while loading dashboard data, a visible error state is rendered with a recovery action (e.g., go to login, retry, or run reset).
ProtectedRoute does not leave the UI in a silent null-render state without any visible feedback during auth restoration.

requirements.text: Ensure the reset flow also clears any in-memory caches that can preserve broken state across navigation (including React Query cache) and then forces a clean navigation to the login screen.
acceptanceCriteria: After reset, React Query cache is cleared and subsequent page loads re-fetch data normally.
After reset, the login page works without requiring an additional manual refresh.

constraints: Do not edit files in frontend immutablePaths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui/*.
Respect the custom SPA routing approach (no React Router introduction).
Backend remains single-actor; do not introduce additional backend services or external databases.
nonGoals: Do not delete or modify canister-stored data such as existing orders, product catalog, or user profiles; the reset is client-side only.
Do not change Razorpay payment behavior beyond what is required to prevent crashes related to routing/auth boot state.
Do not implement third-party authentication providers; Internet Identity remains the only supported identity provider.
